newsitem.title: USA: Russia's Eurobond to follow credit rating - Potanin.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Eurobond to follow credit rating - Potanin.

text.p: Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin said Thursday that the country would issue its inaugural Euobond after receiving a credit rating.
"In principle this (Eurobond) is ready to be issued, but we're waiting the results of the ratings agencies, because we would like to issue the first tranche with a rating," Potanin said.
Russia's Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said Tuesday that the rating would be available within 10 days.
Potanin told a conference here that the government planned to issue the paper by year-end.
"They expect the first tranche of the Eurobond issue to be launched by the end of the year, but they're currently waiting on rating agencies," Potanin said.
